title: Surface
suits: anything set by or in water: pools, swimming, spas, travel, hydration, ocean and climate products, wellness, dreamcore and liminal-space talks; also a 'coming up for air' launch

params.--field: the dry tiled wall above the waterline (light: the word gets dark ink)
params.--rv-wl: the waterline, px from the top

details: a ring of caustic light runs out across the tiles before the word moves; the caustics brighten as it passes
caustics are one tileable Voronoi-edge texture drawn once, two copies min-blended while they drift on amb- keyframes (one clock, prints still)
above the waterline the same texture, stretched and blurred, is the light the water throws back up the dry wall
the word rises with buoyancy: it overshoots a touch and settles
the part still under water is refracted: bent by moving noise, shifted sideways, squashed, tinted toward the water
the part in the air is crisp, and the split follows the waterline exactly
rings spread on the surface where the word breaks through
drops fall from its underside back into the water
a last wobble dies out into crisp type
glazed tiles each with their own glaze, a lit bevel and a grout line; the waterline is a slow swell with a bright crest
